answer: The trial is an isolated sandbox: it only sees sample files or files you upload. It has zero connection to your ERP, bank or payment systems, and nothing is written anywhere outside the trial.
Trial data is deleted automatically after 24 hours, or immediately when you press Reset. Production tenants follow a written retention policy agreed in the contract.
After a signed deal we connect read-only to Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, NetSuite or SAP Business One. The first phase is Shadow Mode: we only read and compare, we never post or pay.
All amounts, tax and matching are computed by deterministic code, not by AI. Live actions stay locked until Shadow Mode shows at least 95% agreement with your team over 50+ invoices.
We check CGST/SGST for intra-state and IGST for inter-state invoices, flag rates that do not match the HSN/SAC schedule, and re-compute every tax total to the paisa.
Pricing is per invoice processed with a monthly minimum; the founder will share a proposal on the call based on your volume.
Shadow Mode is usually live within a week of signing. Assisted mode follows once the accuracy gate is met and your approver signs off.
